text.title: Java Spring Boot Enterprise Patterns Procedure
text.summary: 6-step procedure to scaffold an enterprise Spring Boot 3 service end-to-end.

step.name: add-base-entity
step.action: Create `BaseEntity` with `@MappedSuperclass`, `@Id @GeneratedValue UUID id`, `@CreationTimestamp createdAt`, `@UpdateTimestamp updatedAt`, `@Version Long version`. Every domain entity extends it.
step.decision-gate: If an entity uses sequential `Long` id and is externally exposed, BLOCK per `base-entity-uuid-audit-version` rule.

step.name: add-record-dtos-and-mapstruct
step.action: Define request + response records per resource. Add MapStruct mapper per entity. Configure the annotation processor in `pom.xml`.

step.name: wire-service-readonly-default
step.action: Add `@Transactional(readOnly = true)` at the class level on every `@Service`. Override on write methods with `@Transactional`.
step.decision-gate: If any service lacks the class-level default, fail per `transactional-readonly-default` rule.

step.name: add-search-with-specifications
step.action: Repositories extend `JpaSpecificationExecutor<Entity>`. Build `Specification` factories per filter primitive (`hasStatus`, `nameLike`, `betweenDates`); compose with `Specification.where(...).and(...).or(...)`. Accept `Pageable`.
step.output: Search endpoint with type-safe filters + pagination

step.name: wire-actuator-problemdetail-security
step.action: Add Spring Boot Actuator + Micrometer Prometheus + `springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui`. Configure Spring Security to require auth on Actuator endpoints other than `/health`. Add one `@RestControllerAdvice` extending `ResponseEntityExceptionHandler` that returns `ProblemDetail` for every domain exception and for `handleMethodArgumentNotValid`.
step.output: Observability + auth + error contract in place
step.decision-gate: If Actuator endpoints are open to the public, BLOCK per `actuator-and-micrometer` rule.

step.name: bind-configuration
step.input: Every `@Value` and `System.getenv` call in the module, plus the per-environment override list
step.action: Group the properties by concern and define one `@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.<concern>") @Validated` record per group, constraining every field with Jakarta Bean Validation and registering it with `@EnableConfigurationProperties`. Delete the scattered `@Value` fields and every `System.getenv` / `System.getProperty` read. Replace runtime environment branches with `@Profile`-annotated beans, and feature-flagged beans with `@ConditionalOnProperty`. Boot each profile YAML in turn and confirm a bad value fails startup with a `ConstraintViolation`.
step.output: One validated properties record per concern; profile- and condition-wired beans; green startup across every profile
step.decision-gate: If any bean holds more than three `@Value` annotations, BLOCK per `config-properties-typed` rule.
If a `@ConfigurationProperties` type lacks `@Validated` or leaves a field unconstrained, BLOCK per `config-validation-on-properties` rule.
If a runtime environment check or a `System.getenv` call remains, BLOCK per `config-conditional-on-property` and `config-no-system-getenv` rules.
